description: This source file defines the PdfCryptFilters class, which manages a collection of crypt filters within a PDF security handler. It provides methods to add, retrieve, remove, and enumerate crypt filters, as well as converting dictionary entries to PdfCryptFilter objects.

classes.name: PdfCryptFilters
classes.description: Represents the CF dictionary of a security handler, managing crypt filters in a PDF document.

methods.name: PdfCryptFilters
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty collection of crypt filters.

methods.name: PdfCryptFilters
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection from an existing PdfDictionary.

methods.name: GetCryptFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the crypt filter associated with the specified name.

methods.name: AddCryptFilter
methods.description: Adds a crypt filter to the collection under the specified name.

methods.name: RemoveCryptFilter
methods.description: Removes the crypt filter with the specified name from the collection.

methods.name: GetCryptFilters
methods.description: Enumerates all crypt filters, yielding their names and objects.

methods.name: GetCryptFiltersAsDictionary
methods.description: Returns all crypt filters as a dictionary keyed by their names.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the collection contains any crypt filters.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a PdfItem to a PdfCryptFilter, updating Elements if loaded from file.
